description: Erection of side and rear roof dormer extensions to Nos. 15 and 17 Cambridge Road North.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (10-204 141a  Received:  16 August 2022;  10-204 142a  Received:  01 July 2022;  10 204 101; 10 204 102; 10 204 202
Received:  31 May 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear and side roof dormer extensions to Nos. 15 and 17 Cambridge Road South hereby approved.
